title: gymnogramma scandens
intro: Gymnogramma scandens, commonly known as climbing fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae that grows as a climbing vine. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gymnogramma scandens include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
